goal: An allergen question lands in the middle of a booking. No source can answer it, so the agent escalates and goes silent even for an easy follow-up. The manager answers, sorts it out and hands the conversation back - and the agent carries on from where it stopped, without asking for a single thing it already had.
policy_refs: policy.md #12 if the answer is not in a source
policy.md #13 only a person hands it back
